question: Who is regarded as the knowledge-bodied agitator in this account?
premises: An agitator is required in the process described.
This agitator is characterized as knowledge-bodied.
Lord Ananta is identified with this role.
inference: Therefore Lord Ananta is regarded as the knowledge-bodied agitator.
plain_english: Lord Ananta, whose body is knowledge, is regarded as the agitator.
